constraints: Use Node.js with Express for the application.
Do not modify the existing authentication module under auth/.
Integrate authentication with session middleware from auth/middleware.js.
Use existing date validation in src/utils/dateValidation.js and do not modify.
Deploy in a single-region setup without message queues.
Reminder datetime must be in ISO-8601 format.

performance.loadTest: 100 requests/second for 60 seconds with p99 latency of 200 ms

module_boundaries.todos: TODO CRUD only — no reminder-specific fields on the Todo model
module_boundaries.reminders: Separate Reminder entity/module for schedule + notify
